title: Tobacco and its harm
intro: Smoking harms the smoker and everyone around them – and Islam forbids what harms us.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah (SWT) says: spend in the way of Allah, do not throw yourselves into destruction with your own hands, and do good – Allah loves those who do good. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Baqarah 2:195)</small>
Modern medicine has shown that tobacco greatly harms the human body and also endangers the people around the smoker.

A well-known principle of Islam is that it forbids everything that harms the human body. There is no ayah of the Qur’an that names tobacco or drugs, so the ban on smoking is derived from the harm it does. Medicine also confirms that tobacco causes the illness of addiction, which goes against the principles of Islam.

learn.text: What smoking does to the body

items: illnesses of the heart, bones, stomach and many others.

learn.html: A smoker does huge harm to the health of the people around them – and the longer they smoke, the bigger the harm. This is especially true for the family, and most of all for children, when parents smoke during the time they spend with them.

Research shows that passive smoking – being around smokers – does the same harm, or even more, to the non-smoker as to the smoker. Very great harm is done to a baby before birth if the mother smokes or is around smokers.

Islam allows enjoying life within the limits of the Shari‘ah, but smoking can also be seen as wasteful luxury – going past the limits of normal enjoyment. Besides the harm to health, it costs the smoker and their family money. A Muslim should avoid luxury, especially if they still need to take care of basic family needs, like buying healthy food.
When smokers come to the jama‘ah or join others at the masjid, the smell of tobacco can be so strong that it bothers the people around them and those who are praying.

Muslim men and women should stay away from everything that harms their health, family, property and honour. If someone becomes addicted to tobacco, they must look for a cure. That is why it is important to know the harm tobacco does, so we can protect ourselves and those around us.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Tobacco harms the health of the smoker and of those around them. Research shows that smokers live shorter lives than non-smokers.
